messages:
Marta (AE): Heads-up: OpalFin just escalated to their CTO. They say the POC is blocked and want an exec bridge today. Main blockers: Okta SSO assertion failing (audience mismatch), throughput regression when requests include mixed short+long contexts, and procurement is pushing for a month-to-month pilot price instead of a 12mo commit. Need owners and a quick playbook.

Ethan (Presales): I can draft pilot pricing options (30-day pilot vs 12mo commit + conversion credit). Can someone confirm their expected tokens/day and peak RPS? Procurement mentioned 90k tokens/day and 220 reqs/min peak in their note.

Wei (SRE): Looking at the POC fleet logs: when sessions mix short (<=64) and long (>=1200) requests we hit KV cache churn, p95 spikes. Repro script ready. Propose short canary with kv-prefetch v2. Also see SSO failures show AudienceURI in SAML response = https://opalfin-idp.example/aud, while our SP expects https://redwood/app; likely config mismatch.

Dana (Security): On BYO-KMS: they'll want to know whether keys are ever exported and rotation process. I'll attach the KMS attestation and SOC2 link. Legal needs to approve DPA addendum for BYO-KMS. Also confirm TLS ciphers and IP allowlist options.

Harper (Legal): We can fast-track a scoped DPA addendum for a pilot that covers BYO-KMS. Need exact scope: which systems can access encrypted payloads, rotation frequency, and whether we store any wrapped key material. If HSM required, flag it now.

BridgeBot: Bridge created: BR-7742. Tentative 14:00 PT. Use /bridge confirm to update agenda.

Marta (AE): Owners: Ethan=pricing; Wei=perf/canary; Dana=security artifacts + KMS path; Harper=addendum. Can someone craft a one-liner for the exec invite?

Ethan (Presales): One-liner suggestion: "Run a focused canary with long-context optimizations, complete SSO metadata exchange, and present a 30-day pilot pricing option to close the POC."

Wei (SRE): Kicking off canary with kv-prefetch v2 on a 2-node dedicated pool. Command: `./run_perf --target https://poc.opalfin.redwood/generate --concurrency 100 --seq-mix short:60,long:40 --enable-kv-prefetch`. Will post short results ~10m.

Dana (Security): Uploaded SOC2 + KMS attestation: https://vault.redwood/artifacts/soc2-2025.pdf, https://vault.redwood/artifacts/kms-attest.pdf. Also added a short note on BYO-KMS implications: rotation, access controls, and audit logs.

Wei (SRE): Canary tail: [2026-03-23T13:42Z] run=prf-215 p95=810ms kv_miss=27% ; [2026-03-23T13:55Z] run=prf-216 p95=340ms kv_miss=5.1% (after kv-prefetch). CSV: https://perf.redwood/runs/prf-216.csv. Looks stable at 5% miss.

Harper (Legal): Draft DPA addendum for BYO-KMS uploaded: https://legal.redwood/drafts/opalfin-dpa. Please review; if OpalFin requires HSM-backed keys we'll need to loop counsel but can include an HSM clause.

Marta (AE): Thanks. I'll schedule the 14:00 bridge and invite OpalFin CTO + procurement + our exec sponsor. Need a 1-paragraph agenda to include in invite.

Ethan (Presales): Agenda paragraph: "SRE will present canary perf numbers demonstrating long-context improvement; Security will walk through SOC2, KMS attestations, and BYO-KMS path; Presales will present a 30-day pilot pricing with conversion options; Legal will outline the DPA addendum timeline."

BridgeBot: Reminder: BR-7742 starting in 15 minutes.

Marta (AE): Bridge sent. Post-bridge I'll capture formal pilot pricing and next steps. Quick sync: if bridge goes well we offer a 30-day month-to-month pilot at pilot pricing, with an optional conversion credit toward a 12mo commit. Ethan, please prepare both written quotes.

Ethan (Presales): Will post pricing drafts in channel within 60 minutes.

Wei (SRE): Follow-up: uploading canary CSV and short run notes to the bridge. Also recommend we enable kv-prefetch v2 on OpalFin's dedicated pool if they approve the pilot.

Dana (Security): Sending pre-bridge packet to OpalFin: SOC2 link, KMS attestation, SSO troubleshooting checklist, and the DPA addendum draft. Advisable to request their SAML response (redacted) for faster troubleshooting.

Harper (Legal): I'll aim to have the DPA addendum ready for signature within 24-48 hours after the bridge if they accept pilot. Flag any HSM requirement now.

BridgeBot: BR-7742 closed: notes uploaded and action items created: ACT-9001 (pricing), ACT-9002 (canary CSV), ACT-9003 (DPA draft).

Marta (AE): Post-bridge: OpalFin CTO accepted the canary numbers and the BYO-KMS path. Procurement requested the written 30-day pilot quote and DPA; Ethan and Harper to deliver tomorrow AM. Great job team.
